name: Just Fucking Use shadcn
summary: Blunt single-page guide arguing you should build your UI on shadcn instead of a hand-rolled component library.
description: An opinionated, profanity-heavy guide to adopting shadcn/ui: why owning copy-pasted component code beats maintaining a bespoke library, with chapters on accessibility, dark mode, Tailwind, AI coding tools and building your own registry. It also answers common objections and says when shadcn is not the right call.
contains: arguments: you own the code, accessibility, dark mode, Tailwind, registry
rebuttals to copy-paste and full-library objections
guidance on when to use shadcn
